outcome: A permanent enters the battlefield under the control of the player under whose control it entered, and its owner is the card's owner.
An object an effect puts onto the battlefield enters under the instructed player's control unless the effect says otherwise.
After a player gains control of a permanent spell, the permanent it becomes enters under that player's control.
A nontoken permanent has its printed characteristics as modified by continuous effects.
A permanent that loses all its permanent types stays on the battlefield.
A permanent enters the battlefield untapped, unflipped, face up and phased in unless a spell or ability says otherwise.
A permanent keeps its status (such as flipped) through changes that make the status irrelevant, and it applies again when relevant.
